cd /workspace/02-backend
for s in ki-guv-ai-testing ki-guv-explainability; do
  echo "===== $s ====="
  docker rm -f val-$s 2>/dev/null
  docker run -d --name val-$s -p 18500:8000 \
    -e XT_SERVICE_BASE_URL=http://x -e POSTGRES_USERNAME=u -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=p \
    -e POSTGRES_HOST=x -e POSTGRES_PORT=5432 -e POSTGRES_DB=db -e APP_ENV=local \
    $s >/dev/null 2>&1
  sleep 12
  docker ps -a --filter name=val-$s --format 'STATUS: {{.Status}}'
  docker logs val-$s 2>&1 | grep -E "Uvicorn running|startup complete|ModuleNotFoundError|ImportError|psycopg|No module" | head -4
done
